entities.summary: Craig G. Rogers, is an American urologist and academic surgeon who serves as Chair of the Department of Urology at the Vattikuti Urology Institute, Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit, Michigan. His clinical and academic work has focused on minimally invasive and robotic approaches to urologic oncology, particularly renal surgery using da Vinci Surgical System. In 2009, he received international media attention for participating in a live robotic surgical procedure that incorporated real-time communication via social media.
